reason_for_revision: The v0.3 unconstrained pair-label upper bound is not a realizable binary tip-state bound. With distinct pair-distance ranks 1..M, assigning mismatch to the K largest ranks gives rho_max(K)=sqrt(3*K*(M-K)/(M^2-1)), whose optimum approaches sqrt(3/4)=0.866. For the present n>=20 systems this construction is therefore structurally unable to diagnose a 0.15 ceiling. This defect was identified before any v0.3 outcome was computed.
purpose: Distinguish a realizable single-transition binary-state ceiling from failure of the frozen OU-threshold generator to access that ceiling.
source: Nominal-categorical systems among the 683 novel known-truth system JSONs from workflow 37086693588, with S3 trees rebuilt under the identical pinned BIEN 4.2.8 and V.PhyloMaker2 setup; no real trait values or real memory rho.
realizable_state_family: Every edge of the realized S3 phylogeny defines one binary tip bipartition (descendant clade versus all remaining tips), equivalent to a single state transition on that edge. For each edge split, compute the exact Spearman/point-biserial rho between patristic-distance ranks and pairwise 0/1 mismatch.
primary_quantities: maximum positive rho across all realizable tree-edge splits for each categorical system
fraction of original CALIBRATION_NO_BRACKET systems whose maximum edge-split rho is below 0.15
fraction of original CALIBRATION_NO_BRACKET systems whose maximum edge-split rho is at least 0.15 but whose frozen OU lambda grid still never brackets 0.15
gap between maximum edge-split rho and the maximum frozen OU pilot-median rho
diagnostic_only: Also compute the old unconstrained pair-label upper bound to verify that it is non-discriminating; it is not used as evidence for biological or geometric impossibility.

interpretation.edge_ceiling_below_benchmark: Even a clean one-edge, one-transition binary split cannot reach the common benchmark under binary mismatch plus Spearman on that realized tree geometry.
interpretation.edge_ceiling_at_or_above_benchmark_but_o: The representation/tree can in principle express the benchmark through a simple phylogenetic split, but the frozen OU-threshold generator does not reliably access it over the declared lambda grid.
interpretation.guard: The edge-split maximum is a biologically interpretable attainable family, not a global upper bound over every possible multi-transition binary tip pattern.
